title: Concept: Couchbase error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Couchbase client library error code in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The library code and bucket name disclose the store product and the bucket that holds the records, which shortens a targeted attack.
applicability: Deployments that render a Couchbase client library error code into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The library code and bucket name disclose the store product and the bucket that holds the records, which shortens a targeted attack.
